candidates.source_quality_note: Official USTR press release (archived, still resolves) is the best public market-learning source. Federal Register Proclamation 9694 (published 2018-01-25) is the legal action record.
candidates.anchor_convention_note: Anchor is 2018-01-22 close, the last close before the first positive market reaction. WHR showed no positive intraday reaction on 2018-01-22 (WHR -0.53% while XLY +1.10%). The v2.0 market-model h=1 of +3.64% was computed under OLS intercept+slope adjustment from the same anchor; the v2.1 production BHAR h=1 of +2.36% is the canonical claim. Both are significant; the difference is methodological.
candidates.restricted_because: Q4 2017 earnings released 2018-01-24 at 16:30 ET, after the 16:00 ET market close. First post-earnings session is 2018-01-25. h>=3 includes this session.
candidates.h2_diagnostic_note: h=2 (2018-01-22 close to 2018-01-24 close) is the maximum clean reaction window before earnings contamination. Reported as diagnostic only, not a claimed horizon.
candidates.peer_check_summary: No peer check required for WHR. WHR is the original Section 201 petitioner and the most directly exposed domestic washer producer. Unlike supply-shock candidates (where peer corroboration tests mechanism generality), the tariff-protection mechanism is specific to the petitioner.
candidates.caveat: h=1 and h=2 are clean. h>=3 is earnings-contaminated: Whirlpool Q4 2017 earnings were released 2018-01-24 at 16:30 ET (after the 16:00 ET market close); the first post-earnings session is 2018-01-25. h=5 (AR +7.70%, p=0.0003) and h=20 (AR +3.26%, p=0.44) include this contamination and must not be presented as tariff evidence. h=20 faded, which argues against any long-horizon momentum claim.
candidates.falsifier: WHR does not outperform XLY on 2018-01-23.

candidates.source_quality_note: Official US Army press release dated 2022-12-05. The Army page does not expose an exact publication timestamp in the audited source. A contemporaneous Breaking Defense article was published at 17:29 ET on Dec 5, supporting an after-close announcement convention. TXT showed no positive Dec 5 reaction and first priced the award on Dec 6.
candidates.anchor_convention_note: Anchor is 2022-12-05 close, the last close before the market could react. The Army FLRAA award page is dated Dec 5 but does not expose an exact publication timestamp in the audited source; a contemporaneous Breaking Defense article was published at 17:29 ET, supporting the after-close convention. First tradable reaction date is Dec 6.
candidates.restricted_because: No horizon-specific contamination identified. TXT Q4 2022 earnings were released 2023-01-25, outside the h=20 window. h=5 and h=20 are not statistically significant but are not restricted by a known confound.
candidates.peer_check_summary: TXT-vs-ITA sibling event study softens the paired-loser concern: TXT/ITA h=1 AR +7.09%, SAR +6.65, p < 0.001, larger than TXT/LMT +6.61%. The TXT/LMT result does not appear upward-biased relative to the TXT/ITA cross-check on h=1.
candidates.caveat: LMT is the PAIRED LOSER of the same news (Sikorsky/LMT lost FLRAA to Bell/TXT), not a neutral sector benchmark. Under production BHAR, AR_h1 = TXT_h1_return - LMT_h1_return = +5.25% - (-1.36%) = +6.61%; roughly +1.36% of that comes from LMT itself reacting in the opposite direction on the same news. A sector-ETF benchmark (e.g., ITA) would yield a smaller magnitude; conservative sector-equivalent AR point estimate is approximately TXT's own raw return of +5.25%. The h=5/h=20 flat reads (CAR ~+4%, both insignificant) are consistent with a contained one-time award option-value crystallization, not a weakness.
candidates.falsifier: TXT does not outperform LMT on 2022-12-06.

methodology_notes.event_study_form: Production BHAR via stats.event_study.compute_event_study. AR_h = (P_asset[t+h]/P_asset[t] - 1) - (P_bench[t+h]/P_bench[t] - 1) where t = event_index = the trading day BEFORE first_tradable_reaction_date. sigma_ar_daily = sample stddev (ddof=1) over the 60-bar pre-event estimation window. SAR_h = AR_h / (sigma_ar_daily * sqrt(h)). Daily simple close-to-close returns; auto_adjust=False.
methodology_notes.no_alpha_or_causality_claim: Nothing in this artifact constitutes a claim of causal mechanism, persistent edge, or replicable trading strategy. Each row reports a pre-registered direction, a measured abnormal return on a single named event, and a falsifier.
